name: Chinese poker
summary: Four-player poker variant where each player sets 13 cards into 3-5-5 hands that must increase in strength from front to back.
rules_text: Shuffle a 52-card deck and deal 13 cards to each player. Each player must divide their cards into three hands: front 3 cards, middle 5 cards, back 5 cards. Front can only be high card, pair or trips; middle and back are standard 5-card poker hands. Front must not beat middle, and middle must not beat back in poker strength; an illegal arrangement is penalized. Once set, all players reveal. Each of the three positions is compared pairwise against each opponent. Winning a position scores a point. Bonuses called royalties apply for strong hands like trips in front, full house+ in middle, quads+ in back. Scooping all three from one opponent or all opponents doubles points in some rules. Special 13-card naturals auto-win if declared.
